balls.text: mishits this slower one to extra cover for a single
stays back to jab this shortish delivery to midwicket for a single
goes for the big lofted hit over the off side but is fooled by the slower one and edges to the leg side
They have a fielder between deep midwicekt and long-on and Steyn finds the man. It was the short delivery and he pulled it straight to Botha
full delivery outside off and Steyn frees his arms. He whacks it to the long-off boundary
The bouncer. The pull shot. The good catch at fine-leg. Teja pulled it to fine-leg where Ashok rushed in, slid forward to take it
fullish and well outside off, square driven to point for a single
Paddle paddle! He walked to the off side and paddled the the ball from well outside off to fine-leg boundary. Scoop it up
low full toss, swatted away to the deep for a single
tries the slower one and it has been almost slog-swept to deep midwicket
Slugged! He moved his front leg outside the leg stump and thrashed this full delivery over wide long-on boundary.
gets forward to play the pick-up shot, ala Scott Styris, and it falls just short of long-on
runs this down to third man for a single
slower one outside off, stabbed to the off side of the pitch
another bouncer, pulled down to fine-leg region
Caught at deep midwicket. Trivedi sees the batsman charging out and hurls in a bouncer. Daniel is no position for the pull and ends up swatting an easy catch to the deep.
follows the batsman with a slower one and it goes past the attempted pull
moves outside leg, the bowler follows him with a bouncer and he tries to upper cut but ends up stabbing it to say first slip . The keeper stops
slower one again, dragged across to deep midwicket
slower one outside off, cut to point
moves outside leg, a high full toss, swatted away for a single
moves away and cuts hard but can't pierce the off-side field
Absolute Wallop. Boom. That bottom-hand crunch again. He backed away and slapped the length delivery over wide midwicket boundary
The slower one. Fuller in length this time, pushed back to the bowler
slightly short in length outside off, cut away to deep backward point
punches this to long-on for a single
Thunder! The million-dollary baby went down the track and heaved it over wide long-on
Top shot. Crunchy! It was the quicker and fuller delivery. Daniel used his bottom hand to whip lash it to wide midwicket boundary.
slow off break on the off stump line, dabbed to the off for a single
driven down to long-on for a single
stays back to work it to Warne at midwicket
moves down the track and drags it to long-on for a single
leans forward to push this to extra cover
Lovely shot. It was a delivery outside off, he reached out, waited on the back foot and steered it very late wide of backward point
Another cut. another single to deep point
full delivery outside off, he goes on the back foot to cut it to deep point
slower one - how many does of them does he roll out - pulled away for a single
the bouncer this time and the batsman ducks
fetches this from outside off and drags it to cow corner for couple of runs
short and wide, just tapped to backward point
punches this slower one through to sweeper cover
gets back to punch it to the off side and they get across after some hesitation.

Duminy has been having some trouble picking Warne and he is gone now. He went down the track looking for the leg break. It didn't turn in much. And he ended up slicing it to the off side and long-off ran in to pouch that
turns away from the off stump, cut away to deep cover.
pushes this across Duminy who cuts it to sweeper cover
gets well back to nudge this one straightening on the off stump line to the leg side
leg break from outside off, Duminy goes for the reverse sweep and is hit on the body outside the off stump line
goes down the track to push it to cover
leans forward to defend this to the off side of the pitch
topspinner on the middle and off, driven out to long-off
around off stump, steered to short third man
leans forward to on drive to long-on
works this uppishly through midwicket for a single
leans forward to push this to cover
Another slider, this time quicker and Duminy is beaten again for he once again pushes inside the line.

Stumping appeal First the umpire turned down the caught-behind appeal. Then they go upstairs for the stumping. It was a slider and the batsman stabbed it inside the line. The back foot was inside the line. Was there an edge? Will confirm post a replay
leans forward to drive this to long-on
leans forward to defend to the off
slower, shorter, cut away to deep point region
Hushed silence in the arena. Well not really, not many people there actually. He went down the track and lofts this to long-on. Gone!
topspinner on the off and middle, defended on the front foot
goes down the track to hit to left of the bowler
goes for the paddle sweep, then the paddle scoop but Botha had slowed it up so much that he ends up paddle edging it to square-leg
quicker one, full in length, late cut through backward point
on the middle and off line, turned to point
waits on the front foot and cuts to deep point
gets back to tuck it around the corner, behind square-leg, for a single
low dipping full toss, chipped uppishly but short of midwicket
runs down the track and eases it to long-off
flighted on a length around off and he lunges forward and drag-flicks it like a penalty corner shot in Hockey to long-on
goes down the track again, Warne shortens the length and Duminy turns it to midwicket for a single
Wallop! Duminy ran down the track and heaved his over the tall Oram at long-on.
just outside off, steered to left of backward point
Slower slower and slow death. It was yet another slower one and Chipli goes for the pull. Too early into the shot and he ends up dragging it to his stumps.
in the zone outside off, holding its line, Chipli is beaten on the push
moves outside leg and just goes for a whack. Menaria intercepts at backward point
Yet another slower one and almost a catch at mid-off. Jaggi checked his shot- difficult from that high back lift of his- and he almost scooped it to mid-off. Overthrows allow them to get a run
That slower one again - he bowls so many of em; cut away hard but straight to short extra cover
quicker, on the off stump line, cut away to backward point
flighted full on a length on the middle, slow through the air, the batsman opens his stance and goes down on his knee to slog sweep it
on the middle stump line, turned to midwicket
flighted leg break around off stump line, defended to the off side
pushes this outside leg to see whether he goes for the sweep. He does and sweeps it almost behind the keeper! Dravid gives chase from slips. Ah! No bat on that. Well done me.
leans forward to drive it back to the bowler
starts off with a lbw shout. Good old days. Crouch and scream, the Warne way! The batsman had gone for a sweep and edged it to his pad
in the channel outside off, Chipli tries to heave it through the on side and misses
on a length around off, pushed out to cover
Chipli starts off with a lovely square drive through cover point.

Sanga is gone. Just like that. Shilpa Shetty roars. Oh well. It was a short-of-length delivery that bounced even as it cut away from Sanga who opened the bat-face and pushed out at it. The keeper lunges to his left to pouch it. Shilpa sways, Trivedi roars, and I need a drink
slower cutter, outside off, tapped to backward point
walks down the track and works it to the leg side
gets back to punch this delivery to point

Done in by the slower one and by his own adrenalin rush. Shikhar went for the big hit but it was the back-of-hand slower one and he ended up dragging the full delivery from outside off to deep midwicket
Spunky cut. It was a short of length delivery outside off and Shikhar stayed side-on and cut it past backward point
That's Shikhar we know. Flamboyant pull. He played it off the front foot. Whoosh. The ball sailed over midwicket boundary
beaten again. This time he tried to push a length delivery towards point but the ball tailed past the edge
Slog and a miss. It was a length delivery outside off and Shikhar went for a big slog over mid-on but no wood on leather
moves outside leg and heaves the length delivery to mid-on
A slower bouncer, well not quite a bouncer but a shortish delivery, drag-pulled to deep square-leg
He backs away and Oram slips in a slower one. Jaggi drags it to deep midwicket region
pushes this to mid-on for a single
Goes for another pull. This was a bouncer and he couldn't keep the ball down. Taylor ran in from the deep and threw in a desperate lunge but couldn't get his palms under it. It just died on him
What an ugly shot! It was a short of length delivery outside off and Shikhar, who likes to pull, went for a flat-batted whack and the ball rolls out to mid-on
Jaggi bhai! He sashays down the track, takes it on the full and he chose to time it sweetly and get the placement right instead of trying to blast it. The ball races to left of mid-off
quicker, just outside off, punched out to short extra cover
slower, full and on the middle, swept to short fine-leg for a single. Dravid fumbles with the ball and had he collected cleanly on the first attempt it could have got interesting
flighted on a length around off, driven down to long-on for a single
goes for the sweep, almost slips in the process but makes some contact and will get a single
on the off stump line, defended on the front foot
full in length and pushed out to mid-off
shuffles across to punch this short of length delivery to extra cover
full in length around off stump line, driven to cover
gets forward to drive to extra cover for a single
It was tripe  - overpitched on the legs and Jaggi whips it away through wide midwicket.
Whackity whack. Again, reminds me of Aag the fire. It was a short of length delivery outside off and Jaggie punches it through cover point
Fab shot. It was overpitched delivery, and Shikhar laces it to the right of mid-off. Neatly done.
Shikhar is more compact, gets behind the line of this to deflect to square-leg fielder
fuller, just outside off, Jaggi checks the shot, from that high back lift, checks it like how Ajit Agarkar would have done; gets an inside edge to square-leg
high back lift but he is slightly late on the punchy shot and the ball rolls away to cover
in the zone outside off and Jaggi is beaten; has a lame poke at it

Almost a run out first ball and instead we get overthrows! Oh well. It was pushed to cover point, the batsman wanted it, the non-striker didn't and eventually he gets across. The throw from Menaria is wide and it races away to the boundary
All over. Another full toss and Botha, promoted to No. 3 by Warne, sweeps it to the boundary. Deccan can't win a single game at the home ground. Yet.
Warnie stands up and applauds. Botha rushed down the track and smashed this over the straight boundary. Boom. Bang.
Top edges this sweep shot but it sails over short fine-leg fielder
Tripe continues. This was a full toss and Botha smashes it to the square-leg boundary
sweeps this to deep backward square-leg region and that's his fifty! Taylor gets across to congratulate him.

Massive! It was a length delivery - not the length you want to be bowling at this juncture- and Rosco has absolutely thrashed him. He cleared that front foot and slapped it high over midwicket boundary. What a crushing blow
the bouncer around off, slightly slower, chopped down to third man
short in length, around off, another slower one, pushed out to cover point for a single
a slower one this time, short in length, pulled to deep midwicket
Top-edged over Sanga! It was the shortish delivery from Ishant and Botha went for the pull
a slower one, bouncing from short of length, beats Taylor, who went for the pull and was struck on the body
short in length outside off, mistimes his cut to the off. But its a no ball. Free hit coming up!
stays back to push another slower one to backward point. What a fine over this was
the slower leg cutter this time, outside off, Botha is too early into the cut shot and misses
the slower one, on the middle and off line, jabbed out to the off
around the off stump line, steered to Duminy at backward point
cuts this down to Mishra at third man for a single
low full toss, looking for the yorker, it swing away a bit, pushed back to the bowler
full delivery around off, driven to the bowler who throws it back at the striker's end. Taylor was outside his crease but gets back in time
gets back to work it though midwicket
goes for a similar shot but this was slower and outside off and he ends up dragging it past square-leg
Six time! Could have been out nearly. It was the Rosco shot - that lunging slog sweep and Chipli jumped at deep midwicket but couldn't reach it. It just about dipped over him.
A lovely late cut from Rosco. He pressed back, opened the bat-face and late cut the leg break to the right of Daniel at first slip
Top edges the reverse sweep. He fetched the leg break from outside leg and went for the reverse sweep. It rolls out to third man region
short in length around off, punched away but straight to Duminy at backward point
short in length,around off and middle, tapped past square-leg
steers this to  point where Duminy makes a diving stop
cuts in to the off and middle line, defended to the on side of the pitch
poor delivery, full and down the leg side, Botha stays back to glance it away to the fine-leg boundary
slower one, full and on the middle, worked through midwicket for couple of runs
leans forward to push the leg break back to the bowler. What a tight over this was.
leans forward to defend this back to Amit Mishra
leg break outside leg, full. Botha whips it to deep midwicket
gets forward to push this back to the bowler
Googles again, cut away to point. Too full to cut.
Another googly from Mishra and this time Botha defends it to the off.
lovely leg cutter, from the middle and off line, moving towards off, Taylor does well to defend it out to the off

Knocked out the off stump with a slower one! Rahul was looking for the powerful drive down the ground but was beaten by the change in pace. Steyn slid his fingers over the seam and the ball slowed down appreciably. And it winked past the big waft and took out the off stump
goes for the yorker, ends up full outside off, dug out to cover
Whack. It was the shortish delivery and Botha plays a nice pull over midwicket
similar delivery and this time Rahul abandons subtlety and cuts it hard but straight down to third man
skids from a good length and holds its line just outside off and Rahul is beaten, trying to run it down to third man
slower, full in length around the off ,driven to long-off
turns from the leg to middle, punched out to sweeper cover
gets back to punch it to long-off for a single
leans forward to push to the off side for a single
Dropped by Shikhar at backward point. Tough chance. It was the googly and Botha played the reverse sweep again. Shikhar dives to his right but couldn't hold on to a very difficult chance
Reverse slap! Botha fetches it from the middle stump line and reverse sweeps it with the turn to third man boundary
moves down the track and hits this to long-off
gets well forward to work it through midwicket for a single
stops just before release and then bowls it on a length around off, driven to long-off
goes down the track for a lofted hit over long-off and ends up slicing it to wide long-off region, clear of the fielder rushing in
shorter in length, on the leg stump line, punched down to long-on
slower, on the middle,. Botha goes for a big lofted hit but that slower pace meant he ended up dragging it through midwicket
front-of-the-hand delivery, straighter one on the off stump line, full in length, off driven to long-off
quickish leg break, Botha hurries back to defend
gets forward to drive this to long-on
drags this one quicker, and shorter, Dravid punches but straight to extra cover
slower, on the middle, Dravid had to wait on the front foot and he ends up dabbing it to the off
leans forward to on drive to wide long-on for  two runs
Blasted! It was a slower one and Botha picked it up this time and crashed it through extra cover
short in length, punched to left of cover for a single
slower cutter, gets back to push it towards cover for a single
slower one, fullish, dragged down to long-on for a single
in the zone outside off, square driven to sweeper cover where Chipli fumbles. Extra run.
short in length around off, pulled away for a single
quicker one, on the middle and leg again,. pushed through wide midwicket for a run.
Botha sweeps this to fine-leg boundary. Mishra threw in a dive near the boundary but couldn't cut it off.
reaches forward to sweep it away to deep midwicket
again on the pads, flicked past square-leg this time
on the middle and leg, edged to short fine-leg fielder
gets back and outside leg and whips this arm-ball to deep midwicket
full in length around off, driven to cover
kicks up from short of length,. Botha hops to tap it down
full in length, moves towards the pad, moves past the attempted flick and rolls to leg slip region
cuts in with bounce, Botha stays back to turn it down to fine-leg region
good-length delivery around off stump line, tapped close on the off side and they rush across for the single
gets forward and unfurls his typical on drive. Wristy and it goes through wide mid-on region
This one cuts away from Botha who watches it sail through to the keeper
cuts in with pace and Botha is beaten by the inward movement, and by the pace, and it thuds in to his thigh
Sanga flies. Amit combusts. It was a short -of-length delivery cutting away from Amit who edges his cut. Sanga dives to his right to take a lovely catch.
ha! It was a full delivery well outside off and Amit goes for a big slog but doesn't connect. His body balance was falling back, towards the leg side and he couldn't just reach out
fuller delivery, seaming away, pushed out to the off side.
Whoa! A flat-batted pull to mid-on from Rahul. He backed away and played the forehand to mid-on
Now its Dravid's turn to get beaten. It was a short-of-length delivery outside off and Dravid went for a cut but can't connect.
And again! This one cuts away from a length from around the off stump and Amit goes fishing. Sanga collects.
Beaten for pace again. This was a good-length delivery on the middle and Amit was in no position to play a cut shot. Not the length for it and the ball goes past the cut and climbs over middle
Beaten again. This time, Amit went down the track, looking for the big lofted straight hit and the ball rushes past the edge. Ishant stares.
This one kicks up appreciably. Amit was late on the pull, beaten by the pace and the bounce. Sanga collects. Gavaskar coos on air: "Ishant is bowling really well here"
Ouch! Dravid goes for the pull but this one skids more than it bounces and it hits him on the waist
square driven to point where Chipli fumbles
shorter in length, dravid cuts but can't beat the point fielder
punches this length delivery to cover.
Crashed! He lunges forward, fetches the full-length delivery from around off and lifts it over the non striker
this one moves in and Dravid clips it to deep square-leg region
full in length, just outside off, sort of holds its line, Dravid jabs it out to the off
full in length on the middle, on driven to mid-on
full in length on the off stump line, pushed out to extra cover
gets forward to push it to wide mid-on region
full pitched on the leg and middle and Dravid flicks it to midwicket
lovely delivery full in a length and holding its line outside off. Rahul was beaten, pushing inside the line.
full delivery on the off stump line, driven out to mid-off
Short and wide, Dravid goes chasing it with an attempted cut but can't reach the wide delivery
shout for a catch by the keeper. It was the short of length delivery outside off and Rahul goes for the cut. Sanga goes up in appeal. There didn't seem any edge, though
Amit Pauniker has just pulled Steyn in some style. It was the short delivery and he swiveled to pull it away to the boundary
short in length around off, punched back to Steyn
shorter delivery, around the leg stump line, Amit thinks about the pull and by then the ball rushes past him
cuts away from Amit who defends to cover
Fab shot. It was a delivery curving away from him and Amit went back to caress it superbly through covers. No violence. Pure timing.
lovely outswinger and the batsman is beaten, going for a big cover drive.
leans forward to deflect this to square-leg
from over the wicket, fullish on the leg, flicked to backward square-leg
moves outside leg and chips the flighted delivery outside leg stump line over the bowler
from over the wicket now and he hurls it full and on the leg and middle line. Driven to mid-on where Daniel Christian mis fields
Shot a ball here! He lunges forward to drag this flighted delivery from the off and middle line over wide midwicket region
floated around the leg stump line and he sweeps it to the fine-leg boundary. Ojha winces.
